The only STOP condition is meeting the\n    performance threshold or being unable to improve.\n\n    Args:\n        problem_size (tuple): The dimensions of the 3D problem grid that was just run (e.g., Px, Py, Pz).\n        topology (tuple): The 3D process topology of the MPI ranks used for the run (e.g., nx, ny, nz).\n        total_instance_cpu (int): The total number of physical CPU cores available in the entire instance.\n        total_instance_memory_gb (int): The total amount of system RAM, in Gigabytes, available in the entire instance.\n        cores_per_node (int): The number of physical CPU cores on a single compute node.\n        threading_hint (int): Specifies the level of SMT/Hyper-Threading to assume (e.g., 1 for no SMT, 2 for SMT).\n        current_fom (float): The measured \"Figure of Merit\" (FOM) from the completed run.\n        executable_command (str): The base command string for the AMG executable, excluding problem size and topology.\n        threshold (float): The performance goal, as a fraction of the theoretical maximum FOM. Defaults to 0.90.\n        ideal_fom_per_core (float): A hardware-specific tuning constant for the max FOM of a single core. Defaults to 4.5e8.\n        efficiency_sweet_spot (float): A tuning constant modeling communication overhead (DOFs/rank for ~76% efficiency). Defaults to 1.0e6.\n        retry_scale_factor (float): The multiplier used to increase problem dimensions on a RETRY. Defaults to 1.5.\n        dofs_per_gb (float): A tuning constant for the memory model (DOFs that fit in 1 GB of RAM). Defaults to 1.2e7.\n        memory_safety_factor (float): A safety margin for memory usage (e.g., only use 95% of available RAM). Defaults to 0.95.\n    Returns:\n        (dict): A dictionary containing 'decision', 'reason', and 'resources'.\n    \"\"\"\n    px, py, pz = problem_size\n    nx, ny, nz = topology\n    total_dofs = px * py * pz\n    total_ranks = nx * ny * nz\n    max_ranks_on_node = cores_per_node * threading_hint\n    num_nodes_in_instance = total_instance_cpu / cores_per_node\n    memory_gb_on_node = total_instance_memory_gb / num_nodes_in_instance\n\n    if total_ranks == 0:\n        next_params = {\"problem_size\": problem_size, \"topology\": (1,1,1)}\n        return {\n            \"decision\": \"RETRY\", \"reason\": \"Topology cannot be zero.\",\n            \"resources\": {\"size\": 1, \"tasks\": 1, \"command\": _build_command_string(executable_command, next_params), \"threads\": threading_hint}\n        }\n\n    if total_ranks > max_ranks_on_node:\n        suggested_topology = _suggest_balanced_topology(max_ranks_on_node)\n        next_params = {\"problem_size\": problem_size, \"topology\": suggested_topology}\n        return {\n            \"decision\": \"RETRY\", \"reason\": f\"Topology of {total_ranks} tasks exceeds the single-node limit of {max_ranks_on_node}. Suggesting smaller topology.\",\n            \"resources\": {\"size\": 1, \"tasks\": max_ranks_on_node, \"command\": _build_command_string(executable_command, next_params), \"threads\": threading_hint}\n        }\n\n    max_dofs = memory_gb_on_node * dofs_per_gb * memory_safety_factor\n    if total_dofs > max_dofs:\n        suggested_problem_size = _suggest_problem_size_from_dofs(max_dofs)\n        next_params = {\"problem_size\": suggested_problem_size, \"topology\": topology}\n        return {\n            \"decision\": \"RETRY\", \"reason\": f\"Memory constraint violated. Suggesting smaller problem size to fit on one node.\",\n            \"resources\": {\"size\": 1, \"tasks\": total_ranks, \"command\": _build_command_string(executable_command, next_params), \"threads\": threading_hint}\n        }\n\n    cpu_per_rank = max_ranks_on_node // total_ranks\n    total_cores_used = total_ranks * cpu_per_rank\n    dofs_per_rank = total_dofs / total_ranks\n    scaling_efficiency = math.tanh(dofs_per_rank / efficiency_sweet_spot)\n    effective_fom_per_core = ideal_fom_per_core * scaling_efficiency\n    theoretical_max_fom = effective_fom_per_core * total_cores_used\n\n    if theoretical_max_fom < 1e-9:\n        return {\"decision\": \"STOP\", \"reason\": \"Theoretical max FOM is zero.\", \"resources\": None}\n    \n    performance_ratio = current_fom / theoretical_max_fom\n\n    if performance_ratio >= threshold:\n        return {\n            \"decision\": \"STOP\", \"reason\": f\"Current FOM {current_fom:.2e} is at {performance_ratio:.1%} of theoretical max {theoretical_max_fom:.2e}. Best achievable performance found.\",\n            \"resources\": None\n        }\n    next_params = {\"problem_size\": next_problem_size, \"topology\": topology}\n    return {\n        \"decision\": \"RETRY\", \"reason\": f\"Performance {performance_ratio:.1%} is below threshold. Suggesting larger problem size.\",\n        \"resources\": {\"size\": 1, \"tasks\": total_ranks, \"command\": _build_command_string(executable_command, next_params), \"threads\": threading_hint}\n    }\n"

# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish)
# A stable and widely used base for production environments.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management to prevent prompts during build
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, dependencies, OpenMPI, and certificates for amg2023
# - build-essential, git, make: Core tools for compiling C/C++ applications from source.
# - ca-certificates: Required for secure network communications (e.g., git clone over HTTPS).
# - openmpi-bin, libopenmpi-dev: The OpenMPI runtime and development libraries.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a dependency for amg.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    make \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libgomp1 && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce final image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Clone the latest version of the amg2023 (LLNL/AMG) source code
RUN git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG.git /opt/amg-src

# Compile the amg2023 application
# The Makefile for the target executable is located in the 'test' subdirectory.
RUN cd /opt/amg-src/test && \
    make

# Install the application executable to a standard system PATH location.
# This makes 'amg' directly available to all users and processes.
RUN cp /opt/amg-src/test/amg /usr/local/bin/

# Clean up the source code directory to minimize the final container image size
RUN rm -rf /opt/amg-src

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# These settings ensure reliable communication over standard TCP networks (eth0)
# and prevent attempts to use high-performance interconnects (e.g., InfiniBand)
# that are typically not available in cloud container environments.
# It also allows oversubscription, which is common in development and testing.
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include=eth0
ENV OMPI_MCA_orte_base_help_aggregate=0
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=1

# Set a default working directory for application data
WORKDIR /data

# Provide a default command.
# This allows for interactive sessions with the container for debugging or manual execution.
# The user will typically override this with `mpirun` commands at runtime.
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish)
# A stable and widely used base for production environments.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management to prevent prompts during build
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, dependencies, OpenMPI, and certificates for amg2023
# - build-essential, git, make: Core tools for compiling C/C++ applications from source.
# - ca-certificates: Required for secure network communications (e.g., git clone over HTTPS).
# - openmpi-bin, libopenmpi-dev: The OpenMPI runtime and development libraries.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a dependency for amg.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    make \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libgomp1 && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce final image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Clone the latest version of the amg2023 (LLNL/AMG) source code
RUN git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG.git /opt/amg-src

# Compile the amg2023 application
# First, run make in the root directory to build the required libraries.
# Then, run make in the 'test' subdirectory to build the final executable.
RUN cd /opt/amg-src && make && cd test && make

# Install the application executable to a standard system PATH location.
# This makes 'amg' directly available to all users and processes.
RUN cp /opt/amg-src/test/amg /usr/local/bin/

# Clean up the source code directory to minimize the final container image size
RUN rm -rf /opt/amg-src

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# These settings ensure reliable communication over standard TCP networks (eth0)
# and prevent attempts to use high-performance interconnects (e.g., InfiniBand)
# that are typically not available in cloud container environments.
# It also allows oversubscription, which is common in development and testing.
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include=eth0
ENV OMPI_MCA_orte_base_help_aggregate=0
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=1

# Set a default working directory for application data
WORKDIR /data

# Provide a default command.
# This allows for interactive sessions with the container for debugging or manual execution.
# The user will typically override this with `mpirun` commands at runtime.
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (Jammy Jellyfish)
# A stable and widely used base for production environments.
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management to prevent prompts during build
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install essential build tools, dependencies, OpenMPI, and certificates for amg2023
# - build-essential, git, make: Core tools for compiling C/C++ applications from source.
# - ca-certificates: Required for secure network communications (e.g., git clone over HTTPS).
# - openmpi-bin, libopenmpi-dev: The OpenMPI runtime and development libraries.
# - libgomp1: Provides the GNU OpenMP runtime library, a dependency for amg.
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    ca-certificates \
    git \
    make \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libgomp1 && \
    # Clean up apt cache to reduce final image size
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Clone the latest version of the amg2023 (LLNL/AMG) source code
RUN git clone https://github.com/LLNL/AMG.git /opt/amg-src

# Compile the amg2023 application
# First, run make in the root directory to build the required libraries.
# Then, run make in the 'test' subdirectory to build the final executable.
RUN cd /opt/amg-src && make && cd test && make

# Install the application executable to a standard system PATH location.
# This makes 'amg' directly available to all users and processes.
RUN cp /opt/amg-src/test/amg /usr/local/bin/

# Clean up the source code directory to minimize the final container image size
RUN rm -rf /opt/amg-src

# Configure OpenMPI for containerized environments like Kubernetes.
# These settings ensure reliable communication over standard TCP networks (eth0)
# and prevent attempts to use high-performance interconnects (e.g., InfiniBand)
# that are typically not available in cloud container environments.
# It also allows oversubscription, which is common in development and testing.
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=tcp,self
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_include=eth0
ENV OMPI_MCA_orte_base_help_aggregate=0
ENV OMPI_MCA_rmaps_base_oversubscribe=1

# Set a default working directory for application data
WORKDIR /data

# Provide a default command.
# This allows for interactive sessions with the container for debugging or manual execution.
# The user will typically override this with `mpirun` commands at runtime.
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

flux-minicluster-manifest
# Corrected MiniCluster manifest to debug and run an AMG experiment.
# This version incorporates fixes based on the provided failure analysis.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the debugging attempt.
  name: amg2023-debug-run1
  # Deploy to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster, set to 1 to run on a single node.
  size: 1

  # Total MPI tasks to run. Set to 24 to fully utilize the selected instance type
  # and prevent oversubscription.
  tasks: 24

  # Per debugging instructions, select a specific instance type for the job.
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: r6a.12xlarge

  # Do not delete pods after the job finishes to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Reduce log verbosity as suggested by the debugging analysis.
  logging:
    quiet: true

  # Define the single application container for the experiment.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # The main container is not a launcher; Flux manages job submission.
      # This MUST be false as per the instructions.
      launcher: false

      # Corrected command with problem size (-n) and a balanced process
      # topology (-P) suitable for 24 tasks.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 128 128 128 -P 4 3 2

      # Environment variables to fix runtime issues and optimize execution.
      # This map format is required by the MiniCluster v1alpha2 CRD.
      environment:
        # Fix: Explicitly provide the path to shared libraries for the dynamic linker.
        LD_LIBRARY_PATH: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu
        # Optimization: Enforce single-threaded execution per MPI rank as required.
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"

# Corrected MiniCluster manifest based on timeout analysis.
# This version enables the Flux launcher, which is required for MPI applications,
# and adheres to the small problem size constraint for testing.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the new debugging attempt.
  name: amg2023-debug-run2
  # Deploy to the default namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The number of pods in the MiniCluster, set to 1 to run on a single node.
  size: 1
  # Total MPI tasks to run. Set to 24 to fully utilize the selected instance.
  tasks: 24

  # Do not delete pods after the job finishes to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Reduce log verbosity as suggested by previous debugging steps.
  logging:
    quiet: true

  # Pod spec additions from the debugging analysis.
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: r6a.12xlarge

  # Define the single application container for the experiment.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023

      # Fix: The launcher property is omitted. Its default value is true, which
      # correctly instructs Flux to use 'flux mini run' to launch the MPI tasks in parallel.
      # This resolves the application hang and timeout from the previous attempt.

      # Command updated to use a small problem size as required for testing.
      # The process topology (-P) is maintained to correctly map to the 24 tasks.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 4 4 4 -P 4 3 2

      # Environment variables to fix runtime issues and optimize execution.
      environment:
        # Explicitly provide the path to shared libraries for the dynamic linker.
        LD_LIBRARY_PATH: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu
        # Enforce single-threaded execution per MPI rank.
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"

# Corrected Kubernetes manifest for the amg2023 MiniCluster.
# This version resolves the resource oversubscription error from the previous run.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name is kept from the previous attempt as this is a correction.
  name: amg2023-run3
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster size is set to 1, ensuring the entire job runs on a single Kubernetes node.
  size: 1

  # FIX: The number of tasks has been reduced from 32 to 24.
  # This aligns with the 24 available CPUs on the selected 'r6a.12xlarge' instance type,
  # resolving the 'unsatisfiable request' error from the Flux scheduler by preventing oversubscription.
  tasks: 24

  # The cleanup policy is set to false to allow for inspection of logs from completed or failed pods.
  cleanup: false

  # Pod specification for the MiniCluster nodes.
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      # This selector ensures the pod schedules on the intended instance type with 24 CPUs.
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: r6a.12xlarge

  # Logging configuration for the Flux operator.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Application container configuration.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # As per instructions, this MUST be false.
      launcher: false

      # FIX: The process topology (-P) is updated to match the new task count.
      # The new topology is 4x3x2, which multiplies to 24 tasks.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 192 192 192 -P 4 3 2

      # Environment variables are retained to ensure correct library paths and single-threaded execution.
      environment:
        # Corrected library path for the dynamic linker.
        LD_LIBRARY_PATH: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: cma
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"

# Corrected MiniCluster manifest to resolve the resource oversubscription error.
# The task count is reduced to match the available CPUs on the selected node.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name is updated for the new corrected run.
  name: amg2023-run5
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster size is set to 1, ensuring the entire job runs on a single Kubernetes node.
  size: 1

  # FIX: The number of tasks is reduced from 32 to 24.
  # This aligns with the 24 available CPUs on the 'r6a.12xlarge' instance,
  # resolving the 'unsatisfiable request' error by preventing oversubscription.
  tasks: 24

  # The cleanup policy is false to allow inspection of logs from completed or failed pods.
  cleanup: false

  # Pod specification for the MiniCluster nodes.
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      # This selector is preserved to target the correct hardware for the experiment.
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: r6a.12xlarge

  # Enforce strict schema validation for the CRD as per instructions.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Application container configuration.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023

      # Per instructions, this MUST be false.
      launcher: false

      # FIX: The process topology (-P) is updated to match the new task count.
      # The new topology is 4x3x2, which multiplies to 24 tasks.
      # The larger problem size is kept as part of the debugging context.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 288 288 288 -P 4 3 2

      # Environment variables are retained for correct library paths and performance tuning.
      environment:
        LD_LIBRARY_PATH: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: cma
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"

# Corrected MiniCluster manifest to resolve the Out of Memory (OOM) error.
# The previous problem size (-n 288 288 288) exceeded the memory capacity
# of the r6a.12xlarge node, causing the pod to be evicted.
# This version reverts to a smaller, previously successful problem size
# (-n 192 192 192) to ensure the job can complete within memory limits.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # The name is kept from the previous attempt as this is a corrected version.
  name: amg2023-run5
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The MiniCluster size is set to 1, ensuring the job runs on a single node.
  size: 1
  # The number of tasks is set to 24 to match the vCPU count of the selected node, preventing oversubscription.
  tasks: 24

  # Pods are not cleaned up on completion to allow for log inspection.
  cleanup: false

  # Pod specification for the MiniCluster nodes.
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      # This selector ensures the pod schedules on the intended instance type.
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: r6a.12xlarge

  # Enforce strict schema validation for the Flux Operator CRD.
  logging:
    strict: true

  # Application container configuration.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:amg2023
      # Per instructions, this MUST be false.
      launcher: false
      # The command is updated with a smaller problem size to fit within the node's memory.
      command: amg -problem 2 -n 192 192 192 -P 4 3 2
      # Environment variables are retained for correct library paths and performance tuning.
      environment:
        LD_LIBRARY_PATH: /usr/lib/x86_64-linux-gnu
        OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism: cma
        OMP_NUM_THREADS: "1"
